EnglishMaster helps you learn English. This policy explains what we store, why, and how you can delete it.

Your name, email address and password (stored securely by our sign-in service, never in plain text); your answers, progress, exam results and certificates; and a log of important account events (for example sign-up, exams and staff actions). We do not collect your location, contacts, photos or advertising IDs, and the app contains no ads or third-party analytics.
Only to run the service: to mark your answers, show your progress, run exams, issue certificates and keep the service secure.

Your teachers and the app administrators can see your name, email address and progress. Anyone who has a certificate code can check that certificate (name, level, score and date). We never sell your data. Data is stored with our hosting provider Supabase in the European Union.
Downloaded questions and answers you give offline are kept on your device until they are sent. Your sign-in is stored encrypted.
You can delete your account at any time in My account → Delete account. Your account and all data linked to it are deleted straight away.
Learners under 13 should use the app with a parent, guardian or teacher.
Questions about your data: use the contact email shown on the app\'s Google Play page, or ask your teacher.
